summary: Dispatches three virtual calls in sequence: zeroes a DWORD field at this+0x104, invokes vtable+64 with argument 0, invokes vtable+44 as (this, 1), then returns the result of invoking vtable+156 on this.

operations.description: Write zero to DWORD field at this+0x104 before dispatch
Invoke virtual function at vtable offset 64 (obj+0x40) with argument 0
Invoke virtual function at vtable offset 44 (obj+0x2C) with arguments (this, 1)
Invoke virtual function at vtable offset 156 (obj+0x9C) on this
Return the result of the vtable offset 156 dispatch

unresolved: Semantics of each virtual dispatch target are unknown; all three are indirect calls with no static callee evidence.
